== Biography ==
Gabriel Aparicio is from Córdoba, Argentina.

== Trivia ==
* Has reached Challenger for the first time at 13 years old.
* He likes to get together with his friends to eat [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asado Asado] and play other games.
* Is [[Kimi (Cristian Aparicio)|Kimi]]'s younger brother, and played against him in the LMF Opening 2019.
* In the [[CBOLÃO League S1 - Legends Stage|CBOLÃO]], '''Ackerman''' was interviewed by [[Rahkys]] but didn't understand a word she said because he didn't know much of the language. This later became a meme in [[Isurus]]' posts.<ref>[https://x.com/teamisurus/status/1947740359112409560 Isurus' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x LLA Player of the Week in the split (Opening 2024)
* 2x LLA All Pro Team (Opening 2021, Closing 2021)
* 1x LLA Outstanding Rookie (Opening 2021)
* 1x CBLOL Regular Season Team (Cup 2026)
* 1x CBLOL Regular Season MVP (Cup 2026)
